messages:
nora: FYI monitoring just flagged a regression in SDK-helpers when used with runtime 3.5.x and model rwi-chat-small in eu-central. p95 and a few timeouts for streaming requests. not catastrophic but we should move fast. :warning:
sre-oncall: seeing the same. error rate + timeouts for streams up ~1.7x. looks correlated with a recent SDK change rolling last night.
kevin: SDK 3.0.0-beta.5 shipped yesterday and introduced a new backpressure/timer tweak. runtime 3.5.x also rolled at same time, so we need to determine where the interaction is.
matt: can we do a regional mitigation first? prefer pinning SDK -> runtime mapping for eu-central to avoid global rollback. idea: keep runtime 3.5.x but force SDK clients to use 2.9.x mapping for this model in eu-central for 24h. deploybot supports an SDK pin routing?
deploybot: Deploybot: Advisory: SDK-model-runtime incompatibility detected. Suggested mitigations: 1) regionally route model=rwi-chat-small traffic from SDK>=3.0 to runtime-tagged v3.4-stable, 2) create a temporary SDK client pin for eu-central, 3) schedule a controlled unpin window. Commands: `/deploy pin-sdk --model rwi-chat-small --sdk 2.9.x --region eu-central --duration 24h --reason "sdk-runtime-streaming-timeouts"`
release-coordinator: if we pin, we need a short release-note line and a customer-facing note for accounts in eu-central using streaming. recommend: "temporary SDK pin for rwi-chat-small in eu-central due to streaming timeouts with SDK 3.0.x; small subset of customers will be routed to 2.9.x-compatible runtime for 24h."
kevin: creating the pin now. running:
```
/deploy pin-sdk --model rwi-chat-small --sdk 2.9.x --region eu-central --duration 24h --reason "sdk-runtime-streaming-timeouts"
```
returning task id 131313.
deploybot: Deploybot: SDK pin created (task 131313). Route applied: SDK>=3.0 clients in eu-central will be routed to runtime v3.4-stable for rwi-chat-small. Rollback lane rb-131313 created.
sre-oncall: enabled additional streaming trace sampling for eu-central (2%) and set monitor: abort and re-route if stream-timeouts >= 1.5x baseline for 10m.
matt: QA, please run streaming smoke with SDK 3.0 + fallback to 2.9 in the staged environment. look for frame drops and reconnects. tagging @qa.
release-coordinator: drafted release-note and a short customer message for accounts page; will wait for final telemetry before publishing.
kevin: infra will also run a canary where runtime 3.5.x receives SDK3 clients but with increased stream buffer size; if that fixes it we can unpin and issue a micropatch to SDK.
ora: timeline: keep pin for 24h or until we validate a patch. plan unpin window tomorrow 04:00 UTC as phased steps if metrics stable: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m hold per step. auto re-pin trigger if stream-timeouts > 1.25x baseline.
sre-oncall: initial telemetry after pin: p95 for streaming dropped from 980ms -> 340ms for pinned cohort; error-timeouts down 70%. good sign. monitoring.
matt: QA smoke passed for fallback behavior. no user-facing regressions observed.
kevin: created the phased-unpin job id pu-131313 with the guardrail. added notes in runbook INF-6200 about SDK/runtime interop.
ora: please also add a small note to the internal changelog and tag eng-runtime + eng-sdk for a joint postmortem if we end up keeping the pin beyond 48h.
release-coordinator: added release-note draft to #release-notes and customer message. will hold publication until 2h stable.
sre-oncall: 90m in pinned: metrics remain stable. if all good, we proceed with the unpin tomorrow as planned.
matt: one more ask: add a temporary telemetry flag to capture full connection lifecycle (open/frames/close) for streaming requests in eu-central for 6h post-unpin. helps root cause if we see regressions.
kevin: done. monitor and triggers are in place. closing this coordination thread 44d keep alerts in #oncall if guardrail fires.
